name: Ironcrag Tortoise
summary: A tortoise the size of a hillock, its shell so crusted with rock and lichen that it passes for part of the mountain.
description: Ironcrag tortoises move a few hundred yards a year, grazing moss off the boulders, and live long enough that shepherds give their grandparents' names to them. Every so often a camp is pitched on one, and wakes up somewhere else.

traits.name: Hillside Mimicry
traits.text: While the tortoise is motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary rock outcrop.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The tortoise deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The tortoise makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Tail
actions.onHit: If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the tortoise.

reactions.name: Shell Retreat
reactions.text: When the tortoise is hit by an attack roll, it pulls into its shell and gains a +4 bonus to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. Until the start of its next turn, its {ref:glossary/speed} is 0 and it gains the same bonus to its AC.
